package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	qt "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

// Neither call passes the identifier `t`. A rule that required one would report
// zero findings here and would have missed both.
func TestNonTFirstArgument(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("sub", func(subT *testing.T) {
		qt.Assert(subT, 1, qt.Equals, 1)
	})

	c := qt.New(t)
	qt.Check(c.TB, 2, qt.Equals, 2)
}
